title: Wizard spell effects
description: Schema for seeds/spell_effects.json: one structured entry per Wizard spell in seeds/spells.json, extracted once by an agent from the spell text. The Go loader (api/internal/adapters/spelleffectsadpt) is the authority and additionally parses every formula; formulas use the grammar documented in api/pkg/formula. Spell ids are the snake_case slug of the English name (lowercase, apostrophes dropped, other non-alphanumerics become '_').

name.description: Spell name exactly as in spells.json

kind.description: buff = modifies a creature for a while (debuffs included); damage = deals hit-point damage; utility = nothing the engine tracks numerically

confidence.description: low = extraction partial or unsure; a note is then required

note.description: Caveats, what is not modelled, source ambiguities. Required when confidence is low.

rounds.description: Only with kind rounds. 1 turn = 10 rounds, 1 hour = 60 rounds, 1 day = 1440 rounds.

charges.description: A pool consumed instead of (or besides) time, e.g. Stoneskin attacks, Mirror Image images.

unit.description: What one charge is: attacks, images, hp_damage_taken...

damage.description: Exactly one of dice, by_level, parts and steps. A spell with modes has no damage of its own: each mode carries its own.

dice.description: Damage of one instance, e.g. (min(level,10))d6 for Fireball

by_level.description: Table keyed by caster level; first row min_level 1, ascending; the last row with min_level <= level applies.

parts.description: One instance split into parts rolled separately, each with what a save does to it, so the GM can drop the part a save negates (docs/adr/0008 step 13). The instance is the parts added up, in this order.

items.description: Exactly one of dice and by_level (same rules as the damage's).

save.description: What a successful save does to this part. Default: the entry's save effect, which must then be none or negates.

steps.description: Dice that change from one round, or one instance, to the next (docs/adr/0008 step 15): exactly one of dice (with count) and list. Their formulas may use step, the 1-based step number; a step may have no damage (0), and the steps after the last one with damage are dropped. Replaces instances and rounds: the steps are the rounds or the instances.

per.description: What one step is: a round of a lasting damage, or one separate roll of the casting.

dice.description: The formula of every step, e.g. (max(min(level,12)-(step-1),0))d6 for Chain Lightning (cap a decreasing dice count at 0).

count.description: With dice: how many steps at most (no dice, 1 to 100 at every level).

list.description: The formula of each step, in order, e.g. [0, 0, "leveld2", "leveld4", "leveld2"] for Incendiary Cloud.

instances.description: Separate damage rolls per casting (missiles, bolts). Default 1.

rounds.description: Rounds over which the damage repeats (Melf's Acid Arrow). Default 1.

type.description: Damage type: fire, cold, acid, force...

modes.description: Cast-time options, picked by the caster when casting (the first is the default), each with its own damage or none (docs/adr/0008 step 14). Only on a damage spell, instead of its damage; keys are unique; at least one mode has damage. Each mode's damage uses the entry's save.

key.description: snake_case, unique in the spell; the UI words it (spellMode.<spell id>.<key>)

damage.description: The damage a cast in this mode rolls; absent: none.

modifiers.description: Scalar buff modifiers, each a formula (a bare number is fine). Signs: to_hit, damage, save, weapon_buff positive = better for the bearer; ac is a change to the AC number, so negative improves AC (descending AC); ac_set* make the AC at best that value and never worsen it; attackers_to_hit is applied to attack rolls made against the bearer; *_pct are percentages (100 = unchanged).

attackers_to_hit_first.description: Replaces attackers_to_hit for the first attack against the bearer

damage_multiplier_pct.description: Multiplies each damage roll, rounded up (Enlarge: 100+10*level)

weapon_buff.description: Magical plus on to-hit and damage

ability_gain.description: Ability score increases keyed by str, dex, con, int, wis or cha. Set exactly one of gain and by_group. Groups: warrior, priest, rogue, wizard (a bard is a rogue).

ability_set.description: Ability score forced to a value, e.g. Fist of Stone sets str to 18/00.

condition.description: When the buff's modifiers apply, if not always.

grant_slots.description: Cast mechanic: casting adds blank extra spell slots worth this many spell levels in all, split by the caster at cast time (default: all level 1). Extra slots go at the long rest (docs/adr/0008 step 9).

consume_item.description: Cast mechanic: casting spends one unit of an inventory item of this type (never a daily item), chosen by the caster when several are left (docs/adr/0008 step 10).

attack_roll.description: Cast mechanic: casting needs a target AC and rolls one spell to-hit d20, never a crit (docs/adr/0002 Consequences).

formula.description: Integer expression over INT, dice NdM, 'level', + - * /, parentheses, min(a,b), max(a,b). 'leveld6' rolls level d6; '(min(level,10))d6' caps the dice. Division truncates. 'step' (only in damage.steps) is the 1-based step number. See api/pkg/formula.
